title.zh: 定下 6 模块求职框架

description.zh: 主投 LLM / AI Engineer。准备拆成定位、简历、项目、技术、编码、面试表现。Docs 改成专栏总览：知识点六列默认收起，项目深挖归面试表现。
description.en: Primary target: LLM / AI Engineer. Prep splits into positioning, resume, projects, technical, coding, and interview performance. Docs are now collapsible columns; project deep dives sit under performance.

description.zh: 搭好个人面试站点：笔记、投递、简历三块，以及时间线、热力图与 2026 倒计时。
description.en: Stand up the personal prep site: docs, companies, resume, plus timeline, heatmap, and the 2026 countdown.
